Write and read the cluster review file

Source: R/clusters.R
write_cluster_decisions.Rd

The review file is a CSV the warehouse owners edit: one row per table with the proposed cluster, role and canonical member, a status column (proposed, confirmed or rejected) and a note. Writing merges with an existing file so that decisions already made are kept and only new tables are added as proposed. Reading returns the decisions for cluster_tables(), where a confirmed row fixes that table's canonical member and a rejected row takes the table out of its cluster.

Usage

write_cluster_decisions(clusters, path)

read_cluster_decisions(path)

Arguments

clusters

The clusters tibble from cluster_tables().

path

Path of the CSV file.

Value

write_cluster_decisions() returns the merged data frame invisibly; read_cluster_decisions() returns a data frame, or NULL if the file does not exist.
